tickets.title: P0: page-object/helper layer over current UI + migrate applications.spec & design.spec
tickets.context:
Lede is a React SPA (see CLAUDE.md). Phase 0 is a PURE E2E TEST REFACTOR — the app (`src/`) is NOT touched at all (scope gate: only `test/**` and `playwright.config.ts` may change; a single `src/` diff fails the phase). Goal (spec Phase 0, cite oracle.md): create a page-object/helper layer so that later UI-redesign phases edit the abstraction, not scattered raw selectors.

Current UI facts (from a code map): login via `test/e2e/helpers/session.ts` (`ensureFirstRunPassword`/`login` → fill `getByLabel('Password',{exact:true})`, click 'Continue'). Create-application: click 'New application' button → `getByRole('dialog')` → fill `getByLabel(/^Company/)`, `getByLabel('Job description',{exact:true})`, `getByLabel(/^Role/)`, click 'Create application'; app cards carry `[data-application-id]`. Tailor via 'Tailor'/'Re-tailor' button; lock via 'Lock final'/'Unlock'. Resume preview canvas selector: `.document-preview canvas`. Letter preview canvas: `[data-testid="letter-preview"] canvas`. Non-white-pixel canvas oracle helper is already inline in applications.spec.ts (`expectLocatorCanvasPainted`) — lift it into the helper layer. Letter flow: 'Generate letter'/'Regenerate letter', 'Undo letter', testids `create-blank-letter`, `letter-edit-greeting`, `letter-edit-paragraph-{i}`. Voice testids `flag-voice-resume`/`flag-voice-letter`/`voice-source-*`/`delete-voice-source-*`. Design-view flow: 'Open design view' link → `/applications/:id/design` → `getByRole('heading',{name:'Design'})`; DesignPanel comboboxes 'Body font' (option 'Arimo (Arial)'), 'Experience order' (option 'Employer first'), color swatch buttons; FitChip text matches `/^Fits \d+ pages? · (comfortable|standard|compact)$/`. TemplateGallery: 'Browse templates' → dialog → `[data-template-id]` cards.

BUILD ONLY THIS: (1) a new helper module `test/e2e/helpers/workspace.ts` exporting page objects / flow helpers for: login (re-export or wrap session.ts), create-application, tailor, generate-letter, open-design, and canvas/pixel capture (`expectLocatorCanvasPainted` + a pixel-diff + a distinct-color-count readback helper — later phases need these). (2) Refactor `applications.spec.ts` and `design.spec.ts` to CONSUME the helpers for these selectors/flows. `playwright.config.ts` may only change to wire helper paths if needed (do not alter projects/servers). This is a mechanical refactor: the SAME tests, same assertions, same behavior — just routed through helpers.

DO NOT: change any test's behavior, delete/rename/skip any test, weaken any assertion, or touch `src/`. No-deletion rule (oracle.md): every existing assertion is preserved.
tickets.acceptance:
- **Test-migration protocol A (oracle.md) applies** — verifier captures `--list` at baseSha itself, checks for no new skip/fixme/only, non-comment tautology-free expect count, load-bearing literals survive, config discovery unchanged.
- `--list` title set identical before/after (verifier-captured); `expect(` non-comment count does not decrease.
- `playwright.config.ts` diff (if any): `projects`/`testMatch`/`grep`/`testIgnore` byte-identical — only helper path/alias wiring permitted (no filter that narrows test discovery).
- **Consolidation is real, not an unused import:** the raw selector strings named in the context (`getByLabel('Password'`, `.document-preview canvas`, the create-application `getByRole('dialog')` flow) drop to ~0 inline in `applications.spec.ts`/`design.spec.ts` (moved into `workspace.ts`); `workspace.ts` exports the named helpers (login/create/tailor/letter/open-design/`expectLocatorCanvasPainted`/pixel-diff/distinct-color-count) that the specs call.
- `git diff --name-only <baseSha>..HEAD` ⊆ {test/**, playwright.config.ts} — ZERO `src/` files.
- Baseline gate green: `bun run check`, build, `bun run lint`, `bunx vitest run`, playwright `chromium`+`auth`+`applications` (non-concurrent; `bun run build` before `applications`).

tickets.title: P0: mutation-probe harness proving helpers still bite (committed evidence)
tickets.context:
Final Phase 0 ticket (PURE TEST — no `src/` changes; the injection is test-side only, via `page.addStyleTag`/`page.evaluate`, NOT an app edit). Phase 0's output is the MEASURING INSTRUMENT for every later phase, so we must prove the migrated helpers actually FAIL when the behavior they assert is broken (red-team C2 — an existence check that can't fail is worthless).

BUILD ONLY THIS: a `test/e2e/mutation-probe.spec.ts` (add to the `applications` project via testMatch already covering `applications`/`design` — if it isn't matched, adjust testMatch minimally, or name the file to match). The probe: log in + create+tailor an application to get a painted resume preview, then TEMPORARILY break the preview canvas via a test-only injection (e.g. `page.addStyleTag` hiding `.document-preview canvas`, or `page.evaluate` zeroing it), and assert the canvas-painted helper (`expectLocatorCanvasPainted` from workspace.ts) FAILS on that injected state — use `expect(async () => await helper(...)).rejects` or a try/catch that fails the test if the helper passes. Then remove the injection and assert the helper passes again. Capture the probe run's stdout as evidence.

Why: proves the pixel/canvas helpers bite. Prefer a contrast structure (broken ⇒ helper fails; fixed ⇒ helper passes) over asserting existence.
tickets.acceptance:
- The broken-state assertion uses a HARD-FAILING api — `await expect(helper(...)).rejects.toThrow()` (fails the test if the promise RESOLVES) — NOT a bare try/catch (which passes vacuously if the injection didn't actually break detection). Then injection removed ⇒ helper PASSES. Both in one green test.
- **The probe is discovered by the standard suite:** `bunx playwright test --project=applications --list` includes the mutation-probe test title (it is a standing regression check, not a one-off script).
- Evidence stdout contains auditable phase markers logged from inside the probe (e.g. `injected: canvas hidden`, the caught error, `restored`) — captured by the INDEPENDENT verifier's run, not the builder's.
- `git diff --name-only <baseSha>..HEAD` ⊆ {test/**} — zero `src/` (verify with `--no-renames`; no `src/` as old or new path).
- Baseline gate green (all three playwright projects; build before `applications`).

tickets.title: P1: WorkspaceShell three-pane layout primitive (rail | editor | preview), responsive
tickets.context:
Lede React SPA. This is the foundational primitive for the whole redesign — build it as a PURE, reusable layout component with NO route coupling (Phase 5 will hoist it to wrap the router Outlet for persistence; Phases 1/3/4 embed it per-surface — it must work both ways). Locked decisions (oracle.md): visual identity FROZEN — compose ONLY from existing tokens in `src/client/styles/tokens.css` (gray canvas, white cards, soft shadows, 8px radius, one blue accent `#2643bd`, IBM Plex); NO palette/type/radius/shadow changes, NO new design axis, NO CSS-in-JS, NO new UI framework. Stack: React + Tailwind reading the tokens + the existing shadcn-ish `ui/` components.

DELIVERABLE: `src/client/components/WorkspaceShell.tsx` exporting a `WorkspaceShell` component with `data-testid="workspace-shell"` composing three regions via props/slots: a section RAIL, an EDITOR pane (`data-testid="editor-pane"`), and an optional PREVIEW pane (document surfaces only — omittable so non-document surfaces degrade with no forced empty third pane). Responsive contract (locked, OQ6): at viewport width ≥1280px the editor pane and preview pane are BOTH visible and co-visible side by side; below 1280px the preview collapses to a toggleable tab/drawer (one activation away, not co-visible) — expose a toggle control for it. Use CSS/Tailwind media/container behavior; the preview column is narrow by design (the fit ladder absorbs it — do not touch the fit ladder). Keyboard/focus: the drawer toggle is a real button with a label.

BUILD ONLY THIS component + a vitest component test. Do NOT wire it into any route yet (that is T011) — that keeps the e2e suite green (no route renders it yet).
tickets.acceptance:
- New vitest test `test/unit/workspace-shell.test.tsx`: with editor+preview slots, `[data-testid="workspace-shell"]` and `[data-testid="editor-pane"]` present; WITHOUT a preview slot, no preview-pane element (degrade). Drawer-toggle test asserts a DOM-LEVEL effect (preview element gains `hidden`/`aria-hidden` or is removed from the tree), not aria-state alone (jsdom has no layout — the ≥1280/‹1280 breakpoint is verified by T011's real-viewport e2e, not here; do not claim it verified in this ticket).
- **No untokenized color/axis introduced:** grep the new file for `#` hex literals, `rgb(`, `hsl(`, and Tailwind arbitrary-value brackets `-[` ⇒ none (only token `var(--…)`/utility classes). No new font-family literal.
- Baseline gate green (`bun run check`, build, lint, `bunx vitest run`, all three playwright projects non-concurrent). vitest count increases (new test file).
- `git diff --name-only <baseSha>..HEAD` ⊆ declared files.

tickets.title: P1: section-rail navigation + collapse (view-state only) with contrast e2e
tickets.context:
Continues Phase 1. The workspace editor region has multiple sections (job, resume parts, cover letter, design). Add SECTION-RAIL navigation + collapse to the WorkspaceShell's rail, driving the `/applications/:id` workspace. Locked decisions (oracle.md): the rail NAVIGATES (jump/scroll to a section's editor region) and COLLAPSES (show/hide a section's editor region). CRITICAL LOCKS: (1) section ORDERING stays the design panel's (`sectionDisplay.order`) — the rail does NOT reorder (no second source of truth). (2) Rail collapse is EDITOR VIEW-STATE ONLY — collapsing folds the editor region and must NEVER mutate `settings.layout` (tailoring input) or `sectionDisplay`/format (document display). Collapse state persists in `localStorage` ONLY — never a server write. Navigation must NOT change the URL and must NOT remount the preview (same DOM node).

DELIVERABLE + contrast e2e (via Phase-0 helpers): rail items for the workspace's sections; clicking one scrolls/focuses that section's editor region; collapse toggles per section. Keep applications.spec green.
tickets.acceptance:
- e2e (nav, positive+contrast): scroll so section S's editor region is out of viewport; activate S in the rail ⇒ S's region heading `toBeInViewport()` UNCONDITIONALLY (the OR-branch is not a sufficient pass on its own; if activeElement is asserted too, that element must also `toBeVisible()`) AND `page.url()` unchanged AND the preview canvas is the SAME DOM node (expando marker survives) AND the canvas pixel data (`toDataURL()`) is unchanged before/after (proves nav didn't repaint/disrupt the preview, not merely non-remount).
- e2e (collapse — **no-server-write protocol E**): intercept requests during collapse and assert ZERO PUT/PATCH/POST to the application/settings route fires (the lock is 'localStorage only, never a server write' — assert directly, not via a field diff); confirm the localStorage collapse-state write happened; S's editor region hidden; preview canvas pixel-identical before/after. (Supplementary: `GET /api/applications/:id` `settings.layout`+`sectionDisplay`/format byte-identical.)
- Baseline gate green (all three playwright projects; build before applications). applications.spec still green.
- `git diff --name-only <baseSha>..HEAD` ⊆ declared files.
